Customer Type Switcher Toggle between Individual and Non-Individual (Corporate) modes. Dynamically updates all panels. entries.title: Customer Type Modes
entries.summary: Individual mode Shows personal details, employment, address, family relationships, individual KYC fields, and individual transaction data. Non-Individual mode Shows company details, business segment, UBO/ownership structure, Power of Attorney, corporate KYC, and corporate transaction data. Mode switching Selecting a mode via the type switcher re-renders all dynamic content. The active tab remains unchanged; only the data changes. Default mode Individual mode is active on page load. 4. Non-Functional Requirements Category Requirement Performance The Customer 360° view must load the initial overview tab within 2 seconds
Subsequent tab switches must complete within 500ms
Responsiveness All tab content must be readable on screen widths of 1280px and above without horizontal scrolling
Security Only authenticated users with the Compliance Analyst or above role may access the Customer 360° view
Sensitive fields (PAN, Aadhaar, account numbers) are masked by default and require explicit reveal
Accessibility All interactive elements must be keyboard navigable
Colour-coded badges must also convey meaning through text labels (not colour alone)
Auditability Any action taken from within the Customer 360° view (e.g., marking a screening match as FP, uploading a document) must be recorded in the Audit tab
Data freshness KYC Gap Score is computed on page load from the latest available data
Print / Export The Export button in the top nav generates a PDF snapshot of the currently visible tab content, with the customer header strip included. 9
